title: Constant folding visitor
prompt: Implement `class FoldVisitor : ExpressionVisitor` that replaces any BinaryExpression with two Constant operands by a single Constant of its computed value (ints only). Also implement `static string Fold(string desc)` no — implement `static Expression<Func<int,int>> FoldExpr(Expression<Func<int,int>> e)` returning the visited (folded) expression.

tests.name: folds
tests.hint: Override VisitBinary: if Left/Right are ConstantExpression of int, return Expression.Constant(computed).
